datasets.name: BankInfo

datasets.name: LogDSest
datasets.sql:
select info from asan_log a where a.status='success' and service=:service and pin=:pin 

and  nvl(docnumber,'XX')= nvl(:doc,'XX') 
and trunc(dat)>=trunc(sysdate)-3
order by id desc

datasets.name: EmployerDataSet
datasets.sql:
select s.id,a.*,nvl(a.EndDate,a.PeriodType)mqavile_bitme from asan_log s,JSON_TABLE(info, '$.Response.Active[*]' COLUMNS (
                         row_number FOR ORDINALITY  ,
                          Voen VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Employer.Voen',
                          Name VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.Employer.Name',
                          WorkerCount VARCHAR2(8) PATH '$.Employer.WorkerCount',
                          LegalAddress VARCHAR2(150) PATH '$.Employer.LegalAddress',
                          Firm_Phone VARCHAR2(150) PATH '$.Employer.Phone',
                          EmlakNovu VARCHAR2(150) PATH '$.Employer.PropertyType.Description',
                         
                          IshciAdi VARCHAR2(80) PATH '$.Employee.Name',
                          Surname VARCHAR2(80) PATH '$.Employee.Surname',
                          Patronymic VARCHAR2(90) PATH '$.Employee.Patronymic',
                          Phone  VARCHAR2(5) PATH '$.Employee.Phone',
                          IshyeriNovu VARCHAR2(15) PATH '$.Employee.WorkPlaceType.Description' ,
                          WorkPlace VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.Employee.WorkPlace',  
                          Position VARCHAR2(120) PATH '$.Employee.Position' , 
                          PositionLabourContract VARCHAR2(90) PATH '$.Employee.PositionLabourContract' ,
                          Salary  VARCHAR2(15) PATH '$.Employee.Salary',
                          WorkCasualType VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Employee.WorkCasualType.Description' ,
                          SSN VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Employee.SSN' , 
                          BeginDate VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Contract.BeginDate',
                          EndDate VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Contract.EndDate',
                          NextEndDate  VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Contract.NextEndDate',
                          PeriodType VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Contract.PeriodType.Description' ,
                          Nomre VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.Contract.Number'            
                          )
                          )a


where id=:id

datasets.name: VoenSet
datasets.sql:
select s.id,  json_value(info, '$.Response.PayerType.Type') AS payer_type,
  json_value(info, '$.Response.PayerType.Description') AS payer_description,
  nvl(json_value(info, '$.Response.NaturalPerson.LegalAddress'), json_value(info, '$.Response.LegalEntity.LegalAddress')) AS legal_address,
  json_value(info, '$.Response.VOENInfo.VOEN') AS voen,
  json_value(info, '$.Response.VOENInfo.CreateDate') AS voen_create_date,
  json_value(info, '$.Response.Chief.Name') AS chief_name,
  json_value(info, '$.Response.Chief.Surname') AS chief_surname,
  json_value(info, '$.Response.Chief.Patronymic') AS chief_patronymic,
  json_value(info, '$.Response.Chief.Name')||' '||
  json_value(info, '$.Response.Chief.Surname')||' '||
  json_value(info, '$.Response.Chief.Patronymic') AS full_name
 from asan_log s

where s.id=:id
